extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students, and researchers interested in British politics, media law, and journalistic scandals
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia-style encyclopedic summary of the Zircon affair (a 1986–87 British scandal around a cancelled BBC documentary), providing a neutral, sourced narrative of events, actors, and aftermath. Intended to inform readers about historical facts, chronology, and relevant legal/political issues.
